note: American Legion-run park on Cedar Lake west of Upsala, with a swimming beach along 600 ft of grassy shoreline, a boat launch and canoe and kayak rentals. Pets are not allowed on the beach or in the day-use area. --Claude
summary: Operator site read: $40 RV ($60 holidays, 3-night holiday minimum, $230/wk), pets $5/day, extra vehicle $5 day pass; reservations by phone/email; open May-Sept (now manual); 65 sites (2012 map: 25 RV / 25 seasonal / 15 tent). Owned and operated by American Legion Post 350, not the township. Google 4.9/47. Not waterfront kept for the RV sites.
flags: OWNERSHIP: the About page says 'The campground is owned and operated by American Legion Post 350, Upsala, MN.' Stored ownership is local (and the note said 'Community memorial park in Elmdale Township'); this reads as private (a veterans' organization). As a private park: $40 base is under the $50 gate; Google Maps 4.9 stars from 47 reviews; website and phone live.

Long-stay check: the operator's 2012 site map has 25 seasonal sites of 65 (about 38%); 40 sites (25 RV + 15 tent) are sold by the night or week. Not mostly seasonal. The map is the one the reservations page still links.

Waterfront: not waterfront kept. The lakeside ground is the day-use park and the tent sites by the boat launch (49-60); the RV sites (2-10, 37-48, 61-64) lie east of the day-use lawn or behind the tent row, roughly 80-150 m from the shore.

Pin 45.81150,-94.62760 is on the boat dock at the shoreline, ~95 m west of the campground; under 250 m. If moved, the RV rows sit near 45.8115,-94.6264 (Google's place pin, at the office, is 45.81222,-94.62566).

Hookups and showers are not stated on the operator's pages (the old note's '59 RV/trailer electric' and 'showers' are unconfirmed; the map shows restrooms and porta-pots). facilities.showers (derived) left as stored.

Note corrected: '66 campsites (59 RV/trailer electric, 7 tent)' contradicts the operator ('Sixty-five (65) Campsites'; map 25 RV / 25 seasonal / 15 tent); 'Community memorial park in Elmdale Township' contradicts 'owned and operated by American Legion Post 350'; dropped 'water, showers, dump', 'Reservable', 'Open May-Sep' (fields hold them or the pages don't state them).
